exposure: birth after a trial of labor
outcome: Death during the first 5 years of life
cohort: Twin pregnancies delivered at 36 weeks of gestation or greater
finding: Compared to prelabor cesarean delivery, twin pregnancies delivered after labor have increased risks for hypoxia-related birth outcomes, with second twins having significantly increased mortality up to 5 years of age.
mod_finding: Compared with prelabor cesarean delivery, twin pregnancies at and beyond 36 weeks of gestation delivered after labor have increased risks for birth outcomes associated with hypoxia, with second twins having significantly increased mortality up to 5 years of age.
